sentences.text: Tom Ashworth is the social worker.
Jamie Rowe is the person being assessed.
The assessment is scheduled as a review, as previously discussed.
The social worker will write notes for the support team, with most information remaining between the social worker and support team.
If Jamie reports someone hurting him, the social worker may need to inform others to keep him safe, but will always tell him first.
Jamie is attending college and does catering on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
Jamie volunteers at the garden centre on Fridays, doing watering and trolley duties.
Jamie sometimes cooks for himself, but staff help with the oven.
Jamie can cook pasta on his own.
Sandra helps Jamie manage his shopping.
Jamie receives money on a Monday and makes a shopping list.
Jamie sees his mother on Sundays, who picks him up and they go to Nan's for dinner.
Sandra and Priya are the staff Jamie gets on with best.
Craig is the night staff member most frequently assigned.
Jamie gets on with Craig 'sometimes' and says he 'gets cross' when Jamie gets up at night.
Craig tells Jamie to go back to bed when Jamie gets up at night for a drink.
Craig pushed Jamie into a wall in the hall outside the kitchen.
Jamie's shoulder hurt when pushed into the wall.
The incident when Craig pushed Jamie occurred on a Thursday night, the night before the garden centre.
Craig kicked Jamie's leg with his foot on the back of his leg.
Craig kicked Jamie's leg three times, and said it was 'messing about' or a joke.
Jamie felt a bit of pain when kicked and had a bruise.
Craig told Jamie not to tell anyone about the kicking, saying if Jamie does, he will lose his flat.
Jamie does not want to lose his flat.
Jamie says Craig has not done anything else to him, but Marcus told him Craig hit Sophie, which Jamie did not see.
A safeguarding team member may want to speak to Jamie, and the social worker will be present or his mother can be present.
The social worker will report the incidents to the safeguarding team at the council.
The social worker will ring Sandra and the manager to ask that Craig does not work at night while the issue is being investigated.
Sandra will arrange alternative night staff if needed.
The social worker will contact Jamie's mother this afternoon.
